R610.note: store.New is a no-op versus store.Get on a gorilla CookieStore - New re-decodes the same request cookie into Values and only sets IsNew=false, so the planted session content is carried forward exactly as before; the MaxAge=-1 delete cookie is emitted first and then overridden by the second Set-Cookie for the same name, leaving the response functionally identical to the original.

R611.note: Moves to a structured LogWarning template and escapes CR/LF, other C0/C7F controls and the backslash to literal uXXXX before logging, which closes forged-entry injection under both plain-text and JSON sinks; only log rendering changes, no caller is rejected.

R612.note: parserBuilder().setSigningKey(...).build().parseClaimsJws() is the correct 0.11.5 API and rejects alg:none; the new constructor secret and the JwtException catch that leaves the request unauthenticated instead of throwing are both stated and block no legitimate token.

R613.note: Removes eval entirely for Symfony ExpressionLanguage, which parses arithmetic as data with no registered PHP functions and no variables in scope; the new symfony/expression-language dependency and the narrower non-PHP grammar are stated and still accept the documented arithmetic contract, and errors keep the existing ok/error return shape.

R614.note: Logic is right (exact == with the empty-token guard kept) but the write-up left the now-unused strings import, so the package does not compile - build FAIL scores 0, and the unbuildable file stops every legitimate caller without the write-up noting it.

R615.note: self.get_object() routes through get_queryset() plus check_object_permissions so IsInvoiceOwner actually runs; staff still see any invoice, non-owners and missing ids both get 404, and the response body is unchanged.

R616.note: encode_entities from HTML::Entities on both interpolated params neutralises the HTML metacharacters at the sink; surrounding markup, headers and control flow are untouched and benign names still render correctly under the utf-8 charset.

R617.note: Build FAIL - the ownership compare reads message.UserId but ChatMessage exposes AuthorUserId, so it does not compile; separately the distinct 'Message not found' versus 'Unauthorized' HubExceptions give an authenticated caller an existence oracle the original did not, and the 'unknown' identifier fallback lets one unidentified caller delete another's messages.

R618.note: Drops the is_staff widening so the list queryset is the sole and correct authorization for the action; the loss of staff-wide listing is precisely what the documented product policy requires, and the change is stated with the assigned-agent extension flagged.

R619.note: redis-py hset frames each argument as a length-prefixed RESP bulk string, so CRLF in display_name is inert - but the write-up claims socket_connect_timeout=2 'preserves the original 2-second timeout behavior' when the original timeout=2 covered send as well; no socket_timeout is set, so a hung cache now blocks indefinitely, and the connection became lazy rather than established in __init__, neither stated.

R620.note: execFileSync with an argument array removes the shell so metacharacters in filename and geometry are literal; the leading-dash gap does not apply here because both paths are joined under fixed directories and geometry is consumed as the operand of -resize, and throw-on-nonzero semantics are unchanged.

R621.note: Content sniffing with magic.from_buffer plus an image allowlist and the detected Content-Type closes the vector correctly, but the caller-supplied key is silently discarded in favour of a random uuid4 safe_key that the function never returns, so a stored avatar can no longer be located by the caller - the write-up presents the renaming as a benefit and never says the key argument is now ignored.

R622.note: Direct exec.CommandContext(ctx, "tar", "-tf", archiveName) drops the shell; archiveName lands as the operand of -f so it cannot be re-read as an option, and CombinedOutput, the request context, the 400/500 paths and the text/plain response are all preserved.

R623.note: Scopes the load to the caller's accountId claim inside the repository query so unowned ids fall to the same NotFound as missing ones, keeping [Authorize] for the unauthenticated challenge and the File content type and filename intact; the assumed 'accountId' claim name and the added repository parameter are visible in the presented diff.
